doc: Intermittent iron and folic acid supplementation during pregnancy in malaria-endemic areas

entries.claim: 对于不能耐受每日补铁或因副作用不接受每日补铁、且孕妇贫血患病率低于20%的人群，推荐孕妇每周一次间歇口服补充120mg元素铁和2.8mg叶酸，以改善母婴结局。
entries.source_doc: Intermittent iron and folic acid supplementation during pregnancy in malaria-endemic areas

entries.claim: 在疟疾流行地区，孕妇的铁和叶酸补充项目应与预防、诊断和治疗疟疾的适当措施同时实施。
entries.source_doc: Intermittent iron and folic acid supplementation during pregnancy in malaria-endemic areas
